notes_for_review: 1. Drone photos 10-13 have a white location pin over the house, so I left them out. Photo 9, the top-down view, looked clean to me (the dark lines are power-line shadows), but please give it a quick look. 2. I didn't use photos 40-44: 40-42 are virtually staged (they add a fridge, a dishwasher and furniture the home doesn't have), and 43-44 plus 8 add a lawn over bare dirt. 3. The home looks newly built (graded lot, fresh porch lumber, film still on the rear slider, no appliances yet), but I didn't call it new construction because the photos don't confirm it. Tell me if you want that added. 4. Please confirm the November 2026 date against the EXIF. 5. Whitesboro is a new town page. The paragraph says George Henry White founded it in the early 1900s, so please check you're happy with that history line.
left_out: 10, 11, 12 and 13: the neighborhood drone shots all have a white location pin over the house. 40, 41 and 42: virtually staged kitchen and living room. They add furniture and appliances that aren't in the home and would pair as before/after with 15 and 18. 8, 43 and 44: virtually landscaped, with a green lawn added over what is actually bare dirt. 4: a second front angle, a near-duplicate of the lead. Near-duplicates skipped: 1-3, 16-19, 21-24, 26, 28-29, 31-32, 34-37 and 39. Also skipped: 5 (porch, close to 6), 37 (water heater closet) and 21 (laundry closet).
